EDIT TARGET (image 1): the transparent 4-column x 3-row atlas of a single fixed 3D sedan. Image 2 is ONLY an appearance/style reference for the white Hyundai Avante/Elantra CN7 facelift, NOT a layout/camera reference.
Replace the crude blocky car body in each of the TWELVE cells of image 1 with a clean detailed Korean webtoon illustration of the SAME white CN7 sedan: slim horizontal front LEDs, angular black grille, faceted side panels, dark slate-blue windows, five-spoke silver wheels, connected red rear lamps, blank white license plates. Restrained flat/cel shading, thin clean dark contours; no photographic texture or glossy studio reflection.
CRITICAL REGISTRATION: precisely preserve image 1's canvas proportions, 4x3 cell layout, empty margins, camera pose, vehicle heading, overall length/height and physical placement in EVERY cell. Keep EACH visible tire's hub centre, outer radius and lowest contact pixel at exactly the same image coordinates as the guide. Do not zoom, recentre, resize, rotate, or move any car within its cell. Keep far wheels in the same perspective/occlusion positions. Improve styling around those locked wheels; do not copy the larger/repositioned cars from image 2.
These are twelve successive LEFT-side views at 0,15,30,45 / 60,75,90,105 / 120,135,150,165 degrees, camera at tyre-to-waist height. Follow the actual reference geometry exactly, not an approximate invented turntable. No ground, no cast shadows, no contact shadows, no scenery, no grid, no words, numbers, labels, logos, or watermark. All surrounding pixels truly transparent. Output a single transparent 4:3 atlas, ideally 2048x1536, at the same registration as image 1.
